ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the periphery and central vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped to a thick perimeter along the leading edges, a thin border on the trailing edge, and a prominent vertical stripe bisecting the fluke through the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 45 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (1-5px) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge transitioning into sharply upturned, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the interior of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips; small irregular notches on the trailing edge indicate localized tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical black pigmentation column extending from the base of the fluke through the median notch.
